+def _assert_allowed_request(method: str, url: str) -> None:
+    """Enforce the read-only method + endpoint contract before any network I/O."""
+    parsed = urlparse(url)
+    if parsed.scheme != "https" or parsed.netloc != "open.feishu.cn":
+        raise EvidenceError("ENDPOINT_REJECTED")
+    path = parsed.path
+    if path == TOKEN_PATH:
+        if method != "POST":
+            raise EvidenceError("ENDPOINT_REJECTED")
+        return
+    if method != "GET":
+        raise EvidenceError("ENDPOINT_REJECTED")
+    if path == WIKI_NODE_PATH:
+        return
+    if path.startswith(DOCUMENT_PATH_PREFIX):
+        remainder = path[len(DOCUMENT_PATH_PREFIX):]
+        document_id, separator, suffix = remainder.partition("/")
+        if document_id and (not separator or suffix in {"raw_content", "blocks"}):
+            return
+    raise EvidenceError("ENDPOINT_REJECTED")
+
